title: Jungkook Returns to Incheon, Completing US Schedule Ahead of Chuseok
detail: September 21, 2026 — Jungkook arrived at Incheon International Airport on the morning of the 21st after completing his individual US schedule, a day after the other six members flew home from the 2026 iHeartRadio Music Festival in Las Vegas. His return, captured by Korean entertainment outlets under headlines dubbing him the 'Golden Youngest,' brings the full group back in South Korea just ahead of the Chuseok (Hangawi) holiday, observed Sept 24-26, 2026. BTS's next scheduled stop is the Latin American leg of the ARIRANG World Tour, opening in Bogotá on Oct 2.

media.caption: Jungkook arrives at Incheon International Airport, Sept 21, 2026.
